description: Persistence normalization helpers for image blocks and drawing runs.

members.name: ConvertImageBlocksToDrawingRuns
members.description: Converts legacy top-level image blocks into paragraph drawing runs for provider persistence.

members.name: EnumerateDrawingRuns
members.description: Enumerates drawing runs in a full document, including table cells, headers, footers, and notes.

members.name: IsImageBlockOrigin
members.description: Determines whether a drawing run originated from a standalone image block.

members.name: IsSafePersistentImageUrl
members.description: Determines whether an image URL is safe to persist in the document JSON.

members.name: MarkImageBlockOrigin
members.description: Marks a drawing run as a temporary representation of a standalone image block.

members.name: RestoreImageBlocksFromDrawingRuns
members.description: Restores image blocks that were temporarily represented as drawing-only paragraphs.

members.name: Sanitize
members.description: Normalizes image references that are about to cross a provider or export boundary.

members.name: ToImageBlockContent
members.description: Creates an image block payload from a drawing run.
